info.title: Returns Management
info.description:
Buyers initiate returns on Walmart.com for Marketplace items.

Exception categories HAZMAT OTHER and FREIGHT are excluded from buyer initiated returns.

For HAZMAT and OTHER the seller generates the return shipping label and uploads it.

For instructions and the Returns API JSON schema see the [Returns guide](https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/returns-and-refunds-api-overview).

post.description:
Issue refunds for return orders.

A single request may include multiple return order lines.

Use the Refund Order Lines API for non exception category items, including adjustments where the seller sets a partial refund amount.

Exception category items HAZMAT OTHER and FREIGHT are not eligible for the Marketplace Returns Program.

get.description:
Retrieve return orders that match the provided filters, including status, type, creation/last-modified date ranges, and paging. Optionally include replacement attributes. Use this endpoint to monitor RMA activity and reconcile refunds across your catalog.

If no filters are provided, the API returns all return orders for the seller, starting with the most recently created return orders.

For details see the [Returns guide](https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/returns-and-refunds-api-overview).

parameters.name: returnOrderId
parameters.description: Return order identifier also known as RMA number. Use to filter results.

parameters.name: customerOrderId
parameters.description: Customer sales order identifier. Use to filter results.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by return order status. Valid values are INITIATED, DELIVERED, COMPLETED.

parameters.name: replacementInfo
parameters.description: Include replacement return attributes in the response when true. Attributes include replacementCustomerOrderID, returnType, rechargeReason, and returnCancellationReason. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: returnType
parameters.description: Filter by return type. Valid values are PREORDER, REPLACEMENT, REFUND.

parameters.name: isWFSEnabled
parameters.description: Filter Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) returns. Allowed values: Y (WFS only), N (non-WFS only). Omit to return all.

parameters.name: returnCreationStartDate
parameters.description:
Return orders created on or after this date.

Accepts ISO 8601 date or date time. For example 2020-03-16 or 2020-03-16T10:30:15Z.

To pass a timezone offset in a query string, percent encode the plus sign. For example 2020-04-18T10:42:41.000%2B0000.

parameters.name: returnCreationEndDate
parameters.description:
Return orders created on or before this date.

Accepts ISO 8601 date or date time. For example 2020-03-16 or 2020-03-16T10:30:15Z.

To pass a timezone offset in a query string, percent encode the plus sign. For example 2020-04-18T10:42:41.000%2B0000.

parameters.name: returnLastModifiedStartDate
parameters.description:
Return orders modified on or after this date.

Accepts ISO 8601 date or date time. For example 2020-03-16 or 2020-03-16T10:30:15Z.

To pass a timezone offset in a query string, percent encode the plus sign. For example 2020-04-18T10:42:41.000%2B0000.

parameters.name: returnLastModifiedEndDate
parameters.description:
Return orders modified on or before this date.

Accepts ISO 8601 date or date time. For example 2020-03-16 or 2020-03-16T10:30:15Z.

To pass a timezone offset in a query string, percent encode the plus sign. For example 2020-04-18T10:42:41.000%2B0000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of return orders per response. Must not exceed 200.
